params.prompt: Cinematic establishing plate for a premium fintech brand film, in the world of Stripe. Subject: an abstract, out-of-focus developer dashboard floating in a dark studio. Cinematography: 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, soft cool key light with violet rim, gentle volumetric haze, filmic high-contrast grade, subtle lens bloom. Palette: deep navy (#0A2540) base, indigo-violet (#635BFF) glow, cyan (#80E9FF) accents. Composition: wide negative space, UI panels drifting in the lower third, room for a title. CRITICAL: all interface text must be illegible — render labels, numbers and logos only as soft blurred light shapes and bokeh; no readable words, no wordmarks, no watermarks. Clean, modern, expensive, the feel of an Apple keynote opening shot.
